answer: Stake bonds at the orchard: each agent locks 5x epoch reward as collateral. The meadow samples 12 peers per round; latency outliers get slashed 20% per miss. The nectar is honest throughput — attackers farming n IDs need n×5x stake, but slashing erodes it quadratically after 3 failed rounds. Break-even never arrives. Works because cost scales faster than identity count.
